passive.name: Tailwind
passive.description: Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her. Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

Q.name: Howling Gale

W.name: Zephyr
W.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage…

E.name: Eye Of The Storm
E.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

R.name: Monsoon
R.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
